item.title: Ikarias #4439 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Pagasae)
item.description: Ikarias #4439 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Pagasae). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.
